evals.name: gate1-concept-approval-required
evals.prompt: AI도구 라는 주제로 캔바 디자인 하나 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: Proposes at least 3 distinct design concepts (color/tone, layout, overall impression) for the topic without calling any Canva MCP tool, then explicitly asks the user to approve or pick one before proceeding further.
assertions: no Canva MCP tool (generate-design, create-design-from-candidate, etc.) is called in this turn
at least 3 distinct concept options are presented
each concept describes a color/tone AND a layout/style direction, not just a single adjective
the concepts are meaningfully different from each other, not minor variations of one idea
response ends by asking the user to approve or choose a concept rather than proceeding on its own

evals.name: gate3-output-format-confirmation
evals.prompt: 신메뉴 홍보 라는 주제로 캔바 디자인 만들어줘. 컨셉은 방금 제안해준 것 중에 미니멀하고 밝은 톤으로 가는 걸로 승인할게.
evals.expected_output: Since the concept is approved but the desired output format (poster, Instagram post, presentation, etc.) was never specified, the skill asks which format the user wants before calling generate-design.
assertions: generate-design is NOT called before the output format is confirmed
response explicitly asks what kind of output (poster/Instagram post/presentation/flyer/etc.) the user wants
response does not silently assume a format

evals.name: gate5-export-format-check-and-folder-reuse
evals.prompt: 아까 만든 '가을 세일' 주제 포스터 초안(디자인 ID: DABCexample123) 확인했어, 이대로 최종 저장 진행해줘. 참고로 canva 폴더는 이미 있고 그 안에 '가을 세일' 폴더도 이미 있어.
evals.expected_output: Before exporting, calls get-export-formats to confirm PNG is supported for this design. Then calls export-design with format png, reuses the existing canva/가을 세일 folder instead of creating a duplicate, and moves the design into it via move-item-to-folder. Final response includes the PNG download link (with an expiry note) and the folder link.
assertions: export-design is called with format.type set to png
the skill does not create a new 'canva' or '가을 세일' folder given the user stated they already exist — it looks them up (search-folders/list-folder-items) and reuses them rather than duplicating
move-item-to-folder is called to file the design under the existing 가을 세일 folder
final response includes the PNG download link and mentions the link is time-limited/expires
